transcript: How does a painkiller find your pain? It doesn't. That pill has no idea where you hurt. It falls into your stomach, breaks down with acid, and its particles enter your bloodstream, moving throughout your entire body without targeting anything. But pain starts somewhere else. When tissue gets damaged, it releases chemical substances that send signals through your nerves to the brain. Painkillers don't heal anything. All they do is block the pain signal before it reaches the brain. That's why it seems like the pill relieved your pain, but it didn't. It just covered up the symptom, and tomorrow it comes back. And the day after two, and each time you need more, that's the trap. As long as you take pills, you'll depend on them forever. In our monastery, we never mask pain. We heal it from the root. Because pain isn't the problem, it's the messenger. Your body is telling you that something inside has been wrong for too long. And if you silence it with a pill, it stops warning you, but the problem keeps growing in silence. But I want you to understand something deeper. Most chronic pain doesn't come from an injury. It comes from stress. Stress tenses the muscles surrounding the joints and compresses them. Tension accumulated over years becomes back pain, knee pain, headaches, neck pain, emotions you don't release, get trapped in the body, and express themselves as pain. That's why there are people who take painkillers every day, and the pain always returns. Because they silence the messenger, but never listen to the message. The day you calm, what tenses your body? Pain no longer has a reason to exist. Write in the comments without pills. If this made sense to you, and if you want to learn how to eliminate pain from the root, to release the tension that causes it, and to live without depending on any pill, I've spent over 20 years learning in silence how to do it. And everything I know is inside the path back to calm. The link is in my profile.
